# Fixture-only CLI proposal -> review -> rendered reference workflow.
exec pinax init vault --title Contract --json
exec sh -c 'pinax agent note propose --kind note_draft --title "Draft" --stdin --vault vault --json < body.md'
stdout '"proposal_status":"auto_applied"'
! stdout PRIVATE_BODY_SENTINEL
cp stdout proposal.json
contract-fact proposal.json target_object_id NOTE_ID

vault-digest vault before.sha
exec pinax note preview $NOTE_ID --view rendered --vault vault --json
stdout render.view.v1alpha1
! stdout PRIVATE_BODY_SENTINEL
exec pinax note ref $NOTE_ID --vault vault --json
cp stdout ref.json
contract-fact ref.json resolved_revision REV
contract-fact ref.json uri PINAX_URI
exec pinax note ref resolve $PINAX_URI --vault vault --json
stdout '"reference_status":"resolved"'
exec pinax agent note proposal list --vault vault --json
! stdout PRIVATE_BODY_SENTINEL
vault-digest vault after.sha
cmp before.sha after.sha

exec sh -c 'pinax agent note propose --kind note_edit --target "$NOTE_ID" --expected-revision "$REV" --stdin --vault vault --json < edit.md'
stdout '"approval_required":"true"'
cp stdout edit-proposal.json
contract-fact edit-proposal.json proposal_id PROP_ID
vault-digest vault review-before.sha
exec pinax agent note proposal approve $PROP_ID --vault vault --json
stdout '"local_write":"false"'
exec pinax agent note proposal reject $PROP_ID --vault vault --json
stdout '"local_write":"false"'
vault-digest vault review-after.sha
cmp review-before.sha review-after.sha
exec pinax agent note proposal approve $PROP_ID --yes --vault vault --json
stdout '"proposal_status":"approved"'
! exec pinax agent note proposal approve $PROP_ID --yes --vault vault --json
stdout proposal_consumed
exec pinax note preview $NOTE_ID --view rendered --display body --vault vault --json
stdout replacement-marker
! stdout PRIVATE_BODY_SENTINEL
exec pinax agent note proposal stats --vault vault --json
stdout '"approved":"1"'
stdout '"auto_applied":"1"'

-- body.md --
# Fixture draft

PRIVATE_BODY_SENTINEL

-- edit.md --
# Reviewed replacement

replacement-marker
